scientific.integrity: All homotopy conclusions are supported by exhaustive face enumeration and an explicit acyclicity check of the discrete-Morse matching. Literature searches are evidence for originality but not a proof of exhaustive bibliographic absence.
scientific.limitations: The result is specific to the unweighted shortest-path metric on the explicitly defined Dürer graph; the finite matching does not by itself yield a family theorem.

title: Complete graph-metric Vietoris–Rips filtration of the Dürer graph
